Adani Ports Launches Dedicated Empty Container Yard at Mundra

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone (APSEZ) is launching a dedicated empty container yard at its Mundra Port. This initiative aims to streamline container handling, improve turnaround times, and optimize logistics costs. The company expects the new facility to support India's trade growth. Adani Ports holds a 45.5 percent share of India's container market as of FY26. The company's volumes are expected to remain strong, particularly in the second half of the year, despite disruptions from the West Asia war.
